tips.li: A moral guide's Convert ability works best on someone wavering who likes the guide. Content colonists win their certainty back day by day, so a low mood helps a conversion along and a good one slows it.
The conversion ritual lets the moral guide speak to one listener with everyone watching; a well-made altar or ideogram and a good speaker make it likelier to work.

An ideoligion with no moral guide here has nobody to lead it. Naming one gives its believers a leader for their rituals, and someone who can try to convert believers of the colony's other ideoligions.
Talks between believers change certainty slowly. A friendly talk with a devout, well-liked colonist sways the other a little, and an argument only makes both a little more sure of their own faith.
